# Quality control

## Read in the data

We will first read in the data processed in previous sections:

```{r read-data, message=FALSE}
images <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/images.rds")
masks <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/masks.rds")
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/sce_TU_02.rds")
```

## Filter for tumor cells 

```{r}
# Type 
type_df <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, type) %>% unique() %>% group_by(type) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

ggplot(type_df, aes(x = reorder(type,-n), y = n, fill = type))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  theme_classic()+
  #scale_fill_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$type)+
  ylab("Number of patients")+
  xlab("Type")
```

```{r}
# Subset sce to only contain primary tumor cells 
sce <- sce[,sce$type == "primary"]
```

## Image- and cell-level QC

### Image-level

#### Mean marker expression per image

```{r mean-expression-per-image, message=FALSE, fig.height=7}
library(scuttle)

sce$TMA_fine <- paste0(str_split(sce$sample_id, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1])

image_mean <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, 
                                   ids = sce$sample_id, 
                                   statistics="mean",
                                   use.assay.type = "exprs")

dittoHeatmap(image_mean, genes = rownames(sce)[rowData(sce)$use_channel],
             assay = "exprs", cluster_cols = TRUE, scale = "none",
             heatmap.colors = viridis(100), 
             annot.by = c("PID", "TMA_fine","subtype"),
             annotation_colors = list(PID = metadata(sce)$colors$PID,
                                      subtype = metadata(sce)$colors$subtype
                                      ),
             show_colnames = FALSE)

# We observe a subset of samples to have very little signal across all channels (stems from one TMA_fine category)
# We identified this to be from TMA 224.1 block C

# Very high intensities from PKM2, GLUT1, PDK4 ("Housekeeping"?)
```


#### Cell and tissue area

```{r cell-density}
#Load TMA tissue masks
tissue_area <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/tissue_masks_lasse/tissue_area_TissueSegmentation.csv") 

# Add tissue area to SCE
sce$tissue_area <- as.numeric(tissue_area$AreaShape_Area[match(colData(sce)$sample_id,str_split(tissue_area$FileName_Tissue_Mask, "_Pro",simplify = TRUE)[,1])])


# Check distribution of tissue areas 
cell_density <- colData(sce) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    group_by(sample_id) %>%
    summarize(cell_area = sum(area),
              tissue_area = mean(tissue_area), 
              ratio_xy = mean(width_px / height_px)) %>%
  mutate(covered_area = (cell_area / tissue_area)*100) %>%
  mutate(n_cells = as.numeric(table(colData(sce)$sample_id))) %>%
  arrange(covered_area)

ggplot(cell_density, aes(x = tissue_area))+
  geom_histogram()

quantile(cell_density$tissue_area, na.rm = TRUE)


ggplot(cell_density) +
  geom_point(aes(reorder(sample_id,covered_area), covered_area, color = covered_area))+ 
  ylim(c(0, 100))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = median(cell_density$covered_area, na.rm = TRUE), linetype="dashed", color = "grey")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = quantile(cell_density$covered_area, na.rm = TRUE)[2],linetype="dashed", color = "grey")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = quantile(cell_density$covered_area, na.rm = TRUE)[4],linetype="dashed", color = "grey")+
  theme_classic(base_size = 15)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())+
  ylab("% covered area")+ 
  xlab("")+
  scale_color_viridis()

ggplot(cell_density) +
  geom_point(aes(reorder(sample_id,n_cells), n_cells, color = n_cells))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = median(cell_density$n_cells, na.rm = TRUE), linetype="dashed", color = "grey")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = quantile(cell_density$n_cells, na.rm = TRUE)[2],linetype="dashed", color = "grey")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = quantile(cell_density$n_cells, na.rm = TRUE)[4],linetype="dashed", color = "grey")+
  theme_classic(base_size = 15)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())+
  ylab("Number of cells per ROI")+ 
  xlab("")+
  scale_color_viridis()
```


```{r}
## Visualize critical images
#Kick-out criteria:
image_id_cri <- cell_density %>% filter(n_cells <= 100 | covered_area < 9 | covered_area > 100 | is.na(tissue_area) | tissue_area < 100000 | ratio_xy > 1.5 | ratio_xy < 0.7) %>% pull(sample_id)

# Normalize and clip images
cur_images <- images[names(images) %in% image_id_cri]
cur_images <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images, separateImages = TRUE)
cur_images <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images, inputRange = c(0, 0.2))

plotPixels(cur_images,
           mask = masks[names(masks) %in% image_id_cri],
           img_id = "sample_id",
           missing_colour = "white",
           colour_by = c("H3","DNA1","panCK", "CA9","CD68","CD45"), #Also check H3 here
           colour = list("H3" = c("black","cyan"),
                         "DNA1" = c("black","cyan"),
                         "panCK" = c("black", "yellow"),
                         "CA9" = c("black", "magenta"),
                         "CD68" = c("black", "green"),
                         "CD45" = c("black","blue")
                         ),
           image_title = list(cex = 0.8),
           legend = list(colour_by.title.cex = 0.7,
                         colour_by.labels.cex = 0.7), 
           save_plot = list(filename = paste0("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/03_QC/cell_density_QC_critical_images_density.png")))
```

#### Add info on pixel artifact 

```{r}
library(readxl)
pixel_removal <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/summary_pixelremoval.xlsx")

pixel_removal$Image <- str_replace(pixel_removal$Image, ":","")
pixel_removal$Image <- str_replace(pixel_removal$Image, "\"","")

# Add logical entry to colData of sce
sce$pixel_artifacts_corrected <- sce$sample_id %in% pixel_removal$Image
```


### Cell-level

#### Remove cells with no nuclear expression 

```{r}
# Add all three nuclear channels together (exprs)
assay_matrix <- assay(sce, "exprs")[c("H3", "DNA1", "DNA2"), ]

nuc_exprs <- colSums(assay_matrix)
nuc_exprs <- unname(nuc_exprs)

# Add to colData
sce$nuc_exprs <- nuc_exprs
```

```{r}
# Check distribution 
hist(sce$nuc_exprs)
quantile(sce$nuc_exprs)

# Set nuc_exprs threshold to 1
threshold <- 1

# Filter images that contain most cells below chosen threshold
img_low_exprs_cells <- colData(sce)%>% as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(nuc_exprs<=threshold)%>%
  group_by(sample_id)%>%
  summarise(count=n())%>%
  arrange(desc(count))%>%
  head(30)%>%
  pull(sample_id)

# Label respective cells (n=1560)
cell_low <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame()%>%
  filter(nuc_exprs<=threshold) %>%
  pull(cell_id)

sce$cell_nuc_low <- ifelse(sce$cell_id %in% cell_low, TRUE, FALSE) 

img_low_exprs_cells

# Check on images 
# Normalize and clip images
cur_images_low_nuc_cells <- images[names(images) %in% img_low_exprs_cells]
cur_images_low_nuc_cells <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images_low_nuc_cells, separateImages = TRUE)
cur_images_low_nuc_cells <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images_low_nuc_cells, inputRange = c(0, 0.2))


plotPixels(cur_images_low_nuc_cells, 
           object = sce,
           mask = masks[names(masks) %in% img_low_exprs_cells],
           cell_id = "ObjectNumber",
           img_id = "sample_id",
           missing_colour = "white",
           colour_by = c("DNA1","DNA2", "H3"),
           colour = list("DNA1" = c("black","cyan"),
                         "DNA2" = c("black", "cyan"),
                         "H3" = c("black", "cyan"),
                         "cell_nuc_low" = c("TRUE" = "yellow",
                                            "FALSE" = "magenta")
                         ),
           image_title = list(cex = 0.8),
           outline_by = "cell_nuc_low",
           image_title = list(cex = 0.8),
           legend = list(colour_by.title.cex = 0.7,
                         colour_by.labels.cex = 0.7),
           save_plot = list(filename = paste0("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/03_QC/images_cells_nuc_exprs_check.png")))

## Looks good overall (two images identified with low marker expression overall)
```

#### Cell size

```{r cellsize_dis, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
colData(sce) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    group_by(sample_id) %>%
    ggplot() +
        geom_boxplot(aes(reorder(sample_id,area), area)) +
        theme_classic(base_size = 15) + 
        theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
        ylab(~ "Cell area " (mu * m^2)) + xlab("")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = median(colData(sce)$area), linetype="dashed", color = "grey")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = quantile(colData(sce)$area)[2],linetype="dashed", color = "grey")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = quantile(colData(sce)$area)[4],linetype="dashed", color = "grey")

#Cell area range
summary(sce$area)

area_stats <- colData(sce) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>% select(sample_id,area) %>% unique() %>%
    group_by(sample_id) %>% mutate(mean_area = mean(area), max_area = max(area)) %>% arrange(desc(mean_area)) %>% select(sample_id, mean_area, max_area) %>% unique()

ggplot(area_stats, aes(x = max_area, y = mean_area))+
  geom_point()

# 0.01 & 99.9th percentile cell area normalization
quantile(sce$area, probs = c(0.0001, 0.25, 0.50, 0.9999))

sce$cell_size_critical <- sce$area > 540

summary(sce$area > 536 | sce$area < 15) #n=1985

## Note: Cellpose (in contrary to Mesmer) has sometimes very large cells rather than too small cells
```

```{r}
img_area_critical_2 <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(sample_id, cell_size_critical) %>% filter(cell_size_critical == TRUE) %>% pull(sample_id) %>% unique()

img_area_critical_2 <- img_area_critical_2[1:20]

# Visualize with cytoviewer
library(cytoviewer)

cur_images <- images[names(images) %in% img_area_critical_2]
cur_masks <- masks[names(masks) %in% img_area_critical_2]
cur_sce <- sce[,sce$sample_id %in% img_area_critical_2]
cytoviewer(image = cur_images, mask = cur_masks, object = cur_sce, cell_id = "ObjectNumber", img_id = "sample_id")

## Note: Most of these cells look fine (some are wrong tho..) but due to low numbers I will keep them in the analysis.
```

#### Cell eccentricity 

```{r}
eccentricity_stats <- colData(sce) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>% select(sample_id,eccentricity) %>% unique() %>%
    group_by(sample_id) %>% mutate(mean_eccentricity = mean(eccentricity), max_eccentricity = max(eccentricity)) %>% arrange(desc(mean_eccentricity)) %>% select(sample_id, mean_eccentricity, max_eccentricity) %>% unique()

ggplot(eccentricity_stats, aes(x = max_eccentricity, y = mean_eccentricity))+
  geom_point()

img_eccentricity_critical <- eccentricity_stats %>% filter(mean_eccentricity > 0.7) %>% pull(sample_id) #Identified to be images with high amounts of stromal cells (fibroblasts) = retain in analysis
```


```{r}
cur_images <- images[names(images) %in% img_eccentricity_critical]
cur_masks <- masks[names(masks) %in% img_eccentricity_critical]
cur_sce <- sce[,sce$sample_id %in% img_eccentricity_critical]

unique(cur_sce$subtype_combined)

cytoviewer(image = cur_images, mask = cur_masks, object = cur_sce, cell_id = "ObjectNumber", img_id = "sample_id")
```


## Clinical data quality control

### Add remaining metadata

ZTMA20 has pN and pM information for a subset of patients. 

```{r}
library(readxl)
ZTMA20 <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/data/ZTMA20_BOD2022.xls")

ZTMA20$PID <- str_replace(ZTMA20$PathoNr, " ", "")

ZTMA20$pN_simple <- ifelse(ZTMA20$pN %in% c("0","1","2"), ZTMA20$pN, NA)
ZTMA20$pM_simple <- ZTMA20$pM

# Add this information to SCE 
sce$pN_simple <- ZTMA20$pN_simple[match(sce$PID, ZTMA20$PID)]
sce$pM_simple <- ZTMA20$pM_simple[match(sce$PID, ZTMA20$PID)]
```

```{r}
## Add PDL1 score 
### Combined positive score (> 1%) calculated on all cells in the myeloid panel script (04)
#### Will add here
sce_4 <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_04.rds")

sce$PDL1_score <- sce_4$PDL1_score[match(sce$PID, sce_4$PID)]
```

### Number of images per patient 

```{r}
images_per_PID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, sample_id) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% dplyr::count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

images_per_PID_final <- images_per_PID %>% group_by(n) %>% count(n, name = "total_n")

ggplot(images_per_PID_final, aes(x = n, y = total_n, fill = as.character(n)))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("Number of images per PID")+
  ylab("Number of patients")+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Purples")
```

### Subtype

```{r}
# Re-group subtypes 
sce$subtype_combined <- ifelse(sce$subtype %in% c("clear_cell_RCC", "papillary_RCC", "chromophobe_RCC"), sce$subtype, "other")
sce$subtype_combined[sce$subtype_combined == "clear_cell_RCC"] <- "ccRCC"
sce$subtype_combined[sce$subtype_combined == "papillary_RCC"] <- "pRCC"
sce$subtype_combined[sce$subtype_combined == "chromophobe_RCC"] <- "chrRCC"

metadata(sce)$colors$subtype_combined <- setNames(c("#63A8A0", "#A6CEE3","#C3AAD2","grey"),c("ccRCC","chrRCC","pRCC","other"))  

# Subtype 
subtype_df <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, subtype_combined) %>% unique() %>% group_by(subtype_combined) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

ggplot(subtype_df, aes(x = reorder(subtype_combined,-n), y = n, fill = subtype_combined))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  geom_text(aes(label = n), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), color = "black", size = 4)+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_fill_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$subtype_combined)+
  ylab("Number of patients")+
  xlab("Subtype")
```

### Survival of CC 

```{r}
## Update survival censoring
sce$status_OS <- ifelse(sce$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 1, 0, 
       ifelse(sce$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 0, 1, sce$censor_dead_0_alive_1))

sce$OS_months <- sce$survival_months

## Combine relevant disease progression categories and set colors
### Tumor stage
sce$pT_combined <- ifelse(sce$pT_simple %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(sce$pT_simple %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", sce$pT_simple))
metadata(sce)$colors$pT_combined <- setNames(c("#ABCFE5", "#08306B"),c("1/2","3/4")) 

### ISUP grade 
sce$ISUP_combined <- ifelse(sce$ISUP %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(sce$ISUP %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", sce$ISUP))
metadata(sce)$colors$ISUP_combined <- setNames(c("#FC9F81", "#67000D"),c("1/2","3/4")) 

sce$lymphocytes_combined <- ifelse(sce$lymphocytes %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", sce$lymphocytes)

### Necrosis 
metadata(sce)$colors$necrose <- setNames(c("#d8b2ff", "#3F007D"),c("0","1"))

### PDL1 score
metadata(sce)$colors$PDL1_score <- setNames(c("#AADBAB","#00441B"),c("0", "1"))
```

#### Statistical association of clinical categories 

```{r}
# Proportion of scores per PID groups 
out_p <- list()

for(i in c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined", "necrose", "PDL1_score")){
  for(y in c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined", "necrose", "PDL1_score")){
    if(i != y){
    out <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, any_of(i), any_of(y)) %>% unique %>% select(-PID) %>% group_by(all_of(i)) %>% table() %>%
      as.data.frame
    cur_test <- out %>% pivot_wider(names_from = i, id_cols = y, values_from = Freq) %>% column_to_rownames(y)
    cur_test_out <- chisq.test(cur_test)
    out_p[paste0(i,"_",y)] <- cur_test_out$p.value
    }
  }
}

# Extract direct comparison p-values
direct_comp <- matrix(NA, nrow = 4, ncol = 4, dimnames = list(c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined", "necrose", "PDL1_score"), c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined", "necrose", "PDL1_score")))

for (i in c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined", "necrose", "PDL1_score")) {
  for (j in c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined", "necrose", "PDL1_score")) {
    if (i == j) {
      direct_comp[i, j] <- 1
    } else {
      comp_name <- paste(i, j, sep = "_")
      rev_comp_name <- paste(j, i, sep = "_")
      if (comp_name %in% names(out_p)) {
        direct_comp[i, j] <- out_p[[comp_name]]
      } else if (rev_comp_name %in% names(out_p)) {
        direct_comp[i, j] <- out_p[[rev_comp_name]]
      }
    }
  }
}

# Print the square matrix
corrplot(-log10(direct_comp), 
         is.corr = FALSE, 
         diag = FALSE, 
         tl.col = "black",
         type="upper", 
         col = COL1("Blues",100),
         method = "shade",
         bg = "lightgrey", addCoef.col = "black")
```

## Dimensionality reduction

### Across subtypes 

```{r dim_red}
## Subsample 10% of cells from each core
#to save time and not get super crowded dimensionality reduction plots
set.seed(22)
sub <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% group_by("sample_id") %>% slice_sample(prop = 0.1) %>% arrange("sample_id") %>% mutate(sub_id = paste(sample_id,ObjectNumber,sep="_")) %>% pull(sub_id)
sce_sub <- sce[,sub]

#Run UMAP
sce_sub <- runUMAP(sce_sub[rowData(sce_sub)$use_channel,], n_neighbors = 50, pca = 50,exprs_values = "exprs", external_neighbors=TRUE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam())

plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", colour_by = "subtype_combined")+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$subtype_combined)

plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CA9")+

plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD68")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD11b")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD163")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD16")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "MPO")

plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD45")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD3")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD4")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD8a")

  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$subtype_combined)

  guides(color = "none")

# Visualize all marker expression
all_plots_UMAP <- lapply(c(rownames(sce_sub)[rowData(sce_sub)$use_channel]),
                    function(x){
                      p <- plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", 
                                          colour_by = x, 
                                          by_exprs_values = "exprs",
                                          point_size = 0.5)+
                        guides(color = "none")+
                        ggtitle(paste0(x))
                      return(p)                    
                    })
```
